notes.title: Whisper #1 - Welcome to Cult of the Child Eater
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/2eb2ecf4992f7c3167b818b80093a829952040ba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Welcome to Cult of the Child Eater[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]This is the first of many whispers from our team - fragments carried out of the orphanage, pieces of a story too dreadful to stay hidden. We'll share more of the game's world, secrets, and path to Early Access with each Whisper.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/4aa04a4e0013178f8a619f7024048476481276d7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Source - Where did it all begin?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The seed of the Cult of the Child Eater was planted in the idea of helplessness. Not gore, not endless shock, but the kind of dread that build when you are trapped in a place that should feel safe, and every shadow whispers otherwise[/p][p][/p][p]Set in Eastern Europe in the early 1980s, the game draws from Cold War tension, authentic Eastern Bloc architecture, and folklore surrounding Moloch, the Child Eater - an ancient hunger for sacrifice.[/p][p][/p][p]We asked ourselves: What if the walls of an orphanage concealed a cult that fed children to their god? What if you were the last orphans left on the night of their final ritual?[/p][p][/p][p]The question became the foundation of this game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Orphanage - Not just a setting[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The orphanage is more than a backdrop - it is the enemy. Its main building, abandoned wings, twisted garden, and the woods leading to the lake form a layered trap.[/p][p][/p][p]Every session plays out differently: puzzles rearrange, traps reset, and even the garden maze reshapes itself. Lukas’ notes - fragments left by an orphan who once escaped - provide players with crucial clues to survive.[/p][p][/p][p]Escape is never simple. Unlocking doors, disabling traps, and solving puzzle chains requires precision and teamwork. Mistakes carry weight: the wrong move can trigger alarms or draw attention from the cultists.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/92c3ef3041a29386d2ec586a2c0a185fe81b3eb2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/65c87b91a2737e64048fad96498df0ab7b496c05.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/03603e1f299e5474bc07bade8f61646378483efd.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Phases - A Descent into Terror[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Survival unfolds across three escalating phases:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Phase 1: The Main Building[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The orphanage doors close. Caretakers - priests and nuns - patrol the halls. You have ten minutes to find your way out before the Turning begins.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/c10356c2e1a15480c4cd38266d9a129b40ad4b5c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Phase 2: The Wings & Garden[/b][/p][p][/p][p]These abandoned wings harbor the monsters born from past séances. Somewhere within lurks the Child Eater itself. Puzzles grow deadlier. The garden maze shifts with every attempt, a living trap set to consume you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/56c424406d0ce14a3f4fb19f4c0bf8aefa2c0ab0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Phase 3: The Woods & Lake[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Somewhere within lurks the Child Eater itself. This belongs to phase 3.  Player can decide to face her or run...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/53d66fc1a7c0be5c54eef68d9aa6debef4968cb6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Enemies - The Faces of the Cult[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Fear is not faceless.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Priests crawl walls and ceilings, dropping suddenly onto prey.[/p][/*][*][p]Nuns scream as they hunt, their shrieks shaking your vision.[/p][/*][*][p]Turned caretakers prowl the halls, relentless after the Turning.[/p][/*][*][p]And above them all stands Diana Nowak, once the Abbess, now mutilated into the cult’s avatar: the Child Eater.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Each enemy force different survival tactics. You cannot fight them. You can only hide, distract, and run. But even hiding has limits - the longer you cower, the more fear takes hold.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/8905e6e4a355de709ddc37cf073e5d117f00f9a3.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Orphans - Who You Play As[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]You are not soldiers or heroes. You are children.[/p][p][/p][p]Up to six players can attempt to escape together, though only the cunning and coordinated players survive. Each run reveals more - fragments of Detective Horvath’s journal, notes from Lukas, whispers of the cult’s history.[/p][p][/p][p]Your character will grow over time, unlocking progression that reveals deeper secrets and prepares you for greater horrors in future escapes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/7c732b450cd74eeddfdc2277ca5c8797cfb79d36.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]What's Next[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Early Access Phase 1 will feature the main orphanage building, with puzzles, patrolling enemies, and the Turning. Future updates will expand into the wings, garden, and woods, alongside progression systems and story revelations.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the first Whisper. There are many more to come.[/p][h3]
[b]Follow Cult of the Child Eater[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]You don’t have to enter the orphanage alone. Join our growing community and share your thoughts as we build toward release.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/6Gu3a9qqA2" style="button"]Join the Official Discord[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/UncleGeorgGames" style="button"]Follow us on Twitter[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/unclegeorgegames/" style="button"]Follow us on Facebook[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@unclegeorgegames" style="button"]Follow us on TikTok[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/unclegeorgegames/" style="button"]Follow us on Instagram[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Stay quiet. Stay together. Survive the night.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170640/Cult_of_the_Child_Eater/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Update – postponed Early Access release
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]Release Update – New Timeline [/b][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’ve made the decision to [b]shift the Early Access[/b] and full release of [i]Cult of the Child Eater[/i] by [b]about 2–3 months[/b].[/p][p]This wasn’t an easy call — we know many of you are eager to play — but this extra time will help us deliver the kind of horror experience we’ve always aimed for: one that’s immersive, polished, and fully worth your time.[/p][p]While we haven’t shared much publicly over the past few months, development has never slowed down for a second. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and the current internal version of the game already includes many new features, improvements, and content that go far beyond what’s currently available in the public build.[/p][p][b]Here’s what the extra time is helping us focus on:[/b][/p][list][*][p]More puzzles overall — including co-op-friendly designs that are more satisfying and encourage player collaboration[/p][/*][*][p]Stronger, more dynamic horror moments that build tension[/p][/*][*][p]A plethora of new gameplay features and more extensive progression systems to keep players engaged over time[/p][/*][*][p]A more fleshed-out story with expanded lore and richer worldbuilding[/p][/*][*][p]Extensive bug fixing and polish to improve visuals, boost performance, and ensure a smoother, more stable gameplay experience

[/p][/*][/list][p]And don’t worry — you won’t be left in the dark while we continue development. Starting now, we’ll be posting more regular updates, behind-the-scenes insights, and progress previews across our channels. If you’ve been curious about what’s going on, you’ll be able to follow it all much more closely.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and patience — it means a lot to us.[/p][p]
— Uncle George Games
 Follow our progress:
 [url="https://linktr.ee/uncle.george.games"]linktr.ee/uncle.george.games[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: major incident affecting Unity Services - preventing players to create matches
notes.content: [p]Dear PLayers![/p][p] [b]We are currently experiencing a major incident affecting Unity Services[/b], as reported on their status page. Due to this issue, authentication for the voice chat feature is currently not working.[/p][p] Since voice chat is an essential part of our game, rooms cannot be started while the service is down. This may prevent players from joining or creating matches. [/p][p][b]The issue originates from Unity’s infrastructure[/b], and we are closely monitoring the situation. We will keep you updated and notify you as soon as everything is back to normal.[/p][p][/p][p] Thank you for your understanding and patience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172560/7410fc91ab3a11c1b3a04ddf5bc77db4a9ab7f65.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Patch Note
notes.content:
1.1.43 patch notes:
New Features:

Added unique sound effects for each channeling animation.,
Now there is an automatic puzzle selection when the previous one is solved.,
Added a sound effect and voice line when an Exit door opens.,
Added map indicators to indicate the opening of an Exit door.,
The 5th ping, which puts your pinging on cooldown is now a different color.,

Puzzle Improvements:

Revamped the visual design of the Quiz puzzle.,
Fixed inconsistencies in the new Quiz questions and added brand-new, verified questions.,
Reworked the Picture Sorter puzzle for more dynamic gameplay and resolved related bugs.,
Modified Photo Zoomer: color-based solutions now enlarge pieces instead of changing their color.,
Corrected the Experiment puzzle so players can no longer stack flasks on each other.,

UI Improvements:

Updated Channeling UI to display current action details.,
Journal based solution input now provides proper feedback on incorrect puzzle solutions.,
Added an inventory-full indicator.,
Added even more first-time examine indicators for new items.,
Replaced the "Solve it" Button with "Enter Code" button under journal based solution puzzles.,
Added an "Objectives Updated" indicator on the UI when a puzzle location was revealed on the Map.,

Bug Fixes & Stability:

Fixed several voice-chat issues.,
Multiple minor fixes and polish across UI and systems.

notes.title: PlayTest PatchNote
notes.content:
1.1.29 Patch went live today!

General
Fixed the examine and drop confusion on the Controls UI,,
Unusable (placeholder) items are now not lootable,,
Collectible items are now labeled properly as “Collectibles” (these are just placeholders in the playtest version),,
New tutorial/onboarding screens on first playthrough (can be reset in Settings → Reset Tutorial),,
Puzzle items are now automatically removed from the inventory once they're no longer needed (e.g., fuses and other puzzle items won't clutter your inventory once they are solved),,
Fixed several uninteractable items and incorrect puzzle spawn positions,,
Player icons on the map have been updated for better visibility,,
Added new map icons for players who are downed or being carried,,
All puzzle-related icons on the map are now yellow instead of white,,
Maximized self-revive penalty to prevent it from scaling indefinitely,,

Item Balance Updates:
Several items received buffs,,
Small Mirrors and Sacred Crosses can now be used on both humans and NPCs,,
Small Mirror immobilize duration increased from 6 → 8 seconds for monsters, and now applies 4 seconds to humans,,
Sacred Cross immobilize duration increased from 6 → 8 seconds for humans, and now applies 4 seconds to monsters,,
Increased the sound radius of Firecracker, Radio, and Bottle to attract NPCs more effectively,,
Increased the duration of the Nun soda stamina boost from 10 -> 20 seconds,,
Temporarily removed the Rosary — it will return once fixed,,
Updated item and puzzle descriptions to reflect these changes,,

Puzzle Fixes and Updates:
Fixed a Symbol-based puzzle bug,,
Quiz puzzle questions replaced with ones that emphasize reasoning over vocabulary,,
Fixed an issue with the Mastermind puzzle,,
Fixed an issue with the Nine Buttons puzzle,,
Hot N Cold puzzle functionality changed (no spoilers—figure it out!)

notes.title: Join the Cult of the Child Eater Playtest on 21 Feb 2025!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

This isn’t your typical valentine’s day party ːsteamhappyː. 

This spine chilling event is an exclusive invite to a select few players to test their mettle against the[b] Cult of the Child Eater on Friday, Feb 21, 9:00 am[/b]. This is your chance to experience a part of the game before its early access release and feedback your thoughts directly with us, the game designers.  

[b]What’s in the Playtest? [/b]
[list]
[*] One building, one floor of the main map 
[*] One type of NPC to interact with (or escape from...) 
[*] Three unique puzzles to challenge your mind 
[*] Collectible items with specific uses hidden throughout the area  
[*] You can't play yet against the Child Eater! ːsteamsadː  
[/list]

[b]Playtest Goals: [/b]
We’re looking for feedback on: 
[list]
[*] NPC interactions and possible exploits  
[*] Network stability during multiplayer gameplay  
[*] Feedback on items, teamwork and puzzles  
[/list]

How to Join?  
[list]
[*] Register for the playtest on Steam.  
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/6Gu3a9qqA2]Discord[/url] (Required for testers)  
[*] Share your feedback in the #playtest-feedback channel 
[/list]

Your input will directly influence the development of Cult of the Child Eater.

Keep you posted about the game's story, items  in the game, puzzles, and monsters.
